witnesses.quote: In 2017, Alice was paid $33200. Alice and Bob have been married since Feb 3rd, 2017. Alice is entitled to an additional standard deduction of $600 each for herself and for Bob, under section 63(f)(1)(A) and 63(f)(1)(B), respectively.
